title: MURDLE — Murder at the Investigation Institute
subtitle: 4 suspects, 4 weapons, 4 locations, 4 motives
storyTitle: The Murder of the Theoretical Theologist
storyHtml:
Deductive Logico was called to the Investigation Institute, where a theoretical theologist had been murdered.

Each suspect brought one weapon to one location and had one motive, but only one was the murderer.

Logico examined the clues and questioned the suspects, knowing that exactly one of them was lying.

clues.text: The Amazing Aureolin wanted to escape blackmail.
The person who wanted to see what it felt like to kill was in the Great Tower.
Analysts discovered traces of a weapon made of oil on Dr. Crimson’s clothing.
Chancellor Tuscany had not been in the Observatory.
The Amazing Aureolin said that Principal Applegreen was not in the Great Tower.
Principal Applegreen claimed that Chancellor Tuscany brought the Crystal Dagger.
Chancellor Tuscany said that The Amazing Aureolin was in the Grand Chateau.
Dr. Crimson said that The Amazing Aureolin was not in the Observatory.
The Crystal Ball was clearly used to commit the murder.
